build_finicity_detector: build a detect-secrets plugin using FinicityDetector to scan codebases for Finicity API tokens and client secrets
review_denylist_regex: review the FinicityDetector denylist regex patterns to understand what Finicity credentials are matched
test_finicity_api_token_regex: test the FinicityDetector API token regex against sample code containing a 32-character hex Finicity token
test_finicity_client_secret_regex: test the FinicityDetector client secret regex against sample code containing a 20-character alphanumeric Finicity secret
refactor_secret_type_property: refactor the FinicityDetector secret_type property to return a custom credential label string
